blueprints.name: adversarial-review
blueprints.description: Multi-perspective code review: one agent finds issues, N independent refuters try to disprove each. Only findings that survive the adversarial panel are reported.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: brainstorming-premortem
blueprints.description: Multi-angle idea generation followed by adversarial pre-mortem: surfaces risks before committing to a plan.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: ci-polling
blueprints.description: Polls CI status on a branch. On failure: extracts logs, feeds Claude, applies minimal fix, commits and re-pushes. Loops until green or max attempts. Inspired by loops.elorm.xyz 'Ship PR Until Green' pattern.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: conductor-loop-improvement
blueprints.description: Audits and improves the loop configuration of an existing conductor blueprint — surfaces infinite loop risks, unclear exit conditions, and inadequate max_rounds.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: deploy-verify
blueprints.description: After a deploy, polls health endpoints and runs smoke tests in a loop until stable or rollback threshold reached. Inspired by loops.elorm.xyz 'Deploy Verification Loop' pattern.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: docs-sync
blueprints.description: Automates CHANGELOG, README, and roadmap updates after releases using git log and GitHub issue tracking.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: fetch-web
blueprints.description: Deterministic web fetching pipeline with LLM synthesis. RAG-first: checks local cache before fetching. Tools handle HTTP, LLM handles analysis.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: hook-integration-test
blueprints.description: Implements, registers, tests, and documents a new Claude Code hook through exploration, design, implementation, registration, unit testing, and documentation.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: idea-to-spec
blueprints.description: Transform a raw idea into a structured feature specification with research, cross-module analysis, and validation. Outputs a draft spec ready for backlog grooming.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: onboarding-external
blueprints.description: Simulates the complete onboarding journey for an external user discovering conductor, installing blueprints, and submitting their own. Validates UX fluidity end-to-end.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: pre-push-cohesion-check
blueprints.description: Validates consistency across OSS repos before pushing: README, CHANGELOG, schemas, naming, scrub anti-leak
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: produce-html-page
blueprints.description: Generate a static HTML page from a spec: design → implement → verify. Generic and reusable for any HTML page type.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: self-skill-improvement
blueprints.description: Reads a SKILL.md file via deterministic tool step, analyzes quality, proposes improvements, then adversarial review decides ACCEPT_IMPROVED or KEEP_ORIGINAL.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: spec-to-feature
blueprints.description: Transforms a structured feature spec (T-*.md format) into a complete implementation scaffold with file structure, risk assessment, decomposed tasks, and ready-to-execute tickets.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: spec-to-plan
blueprints.description: Transforms a structured technical specification into a phased implementation plan with atomic tasks, DONE-WHEN criteria, and dependency ordering.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: tdd-bug-hunter
blueprints.description: Adversarial TDD loop: write failing test → fix → verify → repeat until dry
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: node-module-implement
blueprints.description: Implements a Node.js module from a structured ticket spec using a goldenflux hybrid approach: repo analysis → code generation → test verification → quality review.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: pre-push
blueprints.description: Deterministic data leak detection for OSS repos. Scans files against configurable wordlist (YAML) to catch internal IDs, credentials, and personal data before pushing.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: spec-to-roadmap
blueprints.description: Transform a project spec or ticket plan into a versioned roadmap with milestones, defining exactly what ships in each release.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: article-writing
blueprints.description: End-to-end article writing workflow: research, draft, structural edit (Pocock method), anti-slop pass, and publish.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: data-migration-validator
blueprints.description: Pre-execution validation for data migration scripts: idempotence check, data completeness, rollback viability, and edge case handling.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy
